The edit is ready — please approve the file write above (it only reformats headings in `ai/followups/T-0045_followups.md`, no logic changes).

Once approved:

## Post-Fix Actions

1. **Approve the edit above** — reformats the file with `### F-N` H3 headings the parser regex requires.
2. **Retry `propose-followups` for T-0045** from the dashboard — the script will re-read the now-correctly-formatted file and parse all 5 follow-up blocks successfully. No need to re-queue a new prompt or delete any response file; the content is already correct.

The root cause matches BUG-004 in `KNOWN_BUGS.md`: the LLM responded in prose/bullet format (`F-1 •`) instead of the required `### F-1` structured format. The content is valid — only the heading markers were missing.
